scripts.deploy:worker: node scripts/bump-backend-version.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --config backend/worker/wrangler.toml --env=""
scripts.deploy:worker:dev: node scripts/bump-backend-version.mjs && npx wrangler deploy --config backend/worker/wrangler.toml --env=dev
scripts.pages:deploy: VITE_API_BASE=https://escribe-backend.leembory-equestrian.workers.dev npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name escribe --branch main
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run deploy:worker && npm run pages:deploy
scripts.db:seed:recursive:local: npx wrangler d1 execute escribe-dev --config backend/worker/wrangler.toml --env=local --local --file db/lexicon-recursive.sql

scripts.db:seed:all:local: npm run db:seed:recursive:local && npm run db:seed:sabre:local
